snippet.title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator: Demo - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo for Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator is OUT NOW! 🐕🐈

Play it today and don’t forget to wishlist the full game! 🐾
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5188150/Ultimate_Pet_Shop_Simulator_Demo

Build and manage your own pet shop in this first-person simulation. Sell adorable pets, set up stands, decorate your store, keep customers happy, and grow your business into the ultimate pet shop! 🐰🏪
